verdict: PASS — all SCI1–SCI13 proofs, original one-point scopes, checked publications and exact dependency/source bindings independently reviewed.

per_claim_review.title: The exact selected one-point full-block contract
per_claim_review.finding: The theorem is exactly the original normalized one-point h=0, a=n=4, g=0 Core contract. Original ProL, Adapted, given TWAut, GenBy, coefficient surjectivity, Unit-to-t, B1/B2, and stable endpoint antecedents remain present; the intermediate-prime domain is empty.

per_claim_review.title: Checked multiplicity-free Cayley-Hamilton structure theorem
per_claim_review.finding: The published multiplicity-free Cayley–Hamilton theorem applies to the ordinary full CH quotient over the complete Noetherian local quotient C. Residual diagonal characters are distinct and split with one-dimensional blocks; the resulting diagonal corners are C with the determinant trace. No n! or ell>n premise is used.

per_claim_review.title: Trace-kernel equals the full determinant kernel in the actual setting
per_claim_review.finding: The full trace-kernel implication is independently proved. Polynomial cancellation is valid because D(1+t(a-1)) has constant coefficient one; diagonal corner identities persist under scalar extension and show each ze_i lies in the full determinant kernel. The argument works at ell=3.

per_claim_review.title: Full determinant descent to the actual limiting global group
per_claim_review.finding: The original ker relations kill [k]-1 in the full determinant kernel, and the group-algebra quotient is surjective after every scalar extension. This gives the actual descended full law; the profinite quotient map gives the required coefficient continuity.

per_claim_review.title: Complete original OoPair and its exact specialization
per_claim_review.finding: All pulled residual, local-character, polarization, ordered ordinarity and inertia fields of the literal OoPair are supplied. The full-law specialization equality follows by cancelling the surjective pullback, rather than comparing traces only.

per_claim_review.title: Adic generation by the actual determinant and point data
per_claim_review.finding: The original RRObj uniqueness and inherited integral word identity imply uniqueness from all displayed tuple generators. The dual-number derivation and finite graded corrections prove exact GenBy; its quotient image is precisely the OoPt generation set.

per_claim_review.title: One splitting prime with both endpoint primes below it
per_claim_review.finding: Finite positive-rank freeness supplies faithful flatness, and the cited going-down result lifts both endpoint primes below one fixed splitting prime P with exact contractions. The later point and completion use that same P.

per_claim_review.title: Original point lift with exactly the prescribed kernel
per_claim_review.finding: For every prime P over the original point kernel, the field-compositum argument forces all generating roots into the fixed fraction field of K[[t]], because the original characteristic polynomials split there. Integrality and the DVR valuation give the exact map into K[[t]] and exact kernel P.

per_claim_review.title: Actual ordered roots avoid the original patching denominator
per_claim_review.finding: Equality of ordered splitting polynomials in a domain proves the root multiset comparison and distinctness. The literal fEl(1,U) image is the stated product of squared nonzero differences, including the empty q=0 case; the original point eigenvalue and Kap labels are not changed.

per_claim_review.title: Every field of the actual lifted ordinary point
per_claim_review.finding: Every original OoPt field is checked on the same pair, limit, roots and map: finite generation, Ip, coefficient surjectivity, ph/ta, both ordered q relations, GenBy, full determinant/character maps, Unit, Y, distinct roots and eigenvalue polynomial. Its closure kernel is definitionally ooKer.

per_claim_review.title: Actual S5 completion matched to the actual ordinary point
per_claim_review.finding: The S5 center is exactly the kernel of this lifted ordinary point. PMS supplies the actual modules, actions, common ultrafilter, all six relations and support output. The coefficient map has precisely the original normalized kernel and dimension 1+D; the total dimension is 1+D+nq, equal to 1+D0.

per_claim_review.title: Complete selected normalized Core theorem
per_claim_review.finding: The selected one-point Core argument uses the same splitting prime and completion for both endpoint primes. The original support/annihilator equivalence preserves J. A starting support prime yields a minimal component of dimension at least 1+D0; CRW18 forces that component and the support ideal to be zero. The target containment follows without NonssT or any arbitrary-chain consumer.

per_claim_review.title: Complete selected Raw endpoint by normalization and descent
per_claim_review.finding: The actual PQL descent and BCN24/25 normalized one-point transports preserve the selected block/Kap data, original final B,J,K,f, and all B1/B2 quantifiers. They use only SCI12 at h=0,a=n=4,g=0. The original arithmetic TWAut/HasAut and both-link common threshold remain upstream requirements; whole Count-II is not claimed.

published_application_review.checked_theorems: Theorem 2.22(ii), printed pp. 34–35; Definition 2.19 for split multiplicity free.
published_application_review.finding: The actual CH quotient is Cayley–Hamilton over a henselian base with distinct one-dimensional residual constituents. The theorem provides exactly the corner and trace identities used, without small-characteristic exclusions.
The original Spo is finite free and nonzero over B; localizing at the one chosen prime gives a flat local map. The theorem lifts each endpoint with the exact contraction below that same prime.

scope_checks: Every occurrence of the determinant is a full polynomial law; the small prime 3 is retained.
One original limit, RRObj, RMaps, quotient pair, splitting prime, point and completion are kept throughout.
The patched module and support objects are supplied by PMS on the original TWAut, not added as independent axioms.
Coefficient surjectivity and the Unit variable mapping to t are indispensable for the normalized dimension match and are supplied later by BCN.
The conclusion is only the selected h=0,a=n=4,g=0 Core/Raw endpoint; there is no claim for general Kap, arbitrary chain length or whole Count-II.
The same ideal J, both original rank-four Links, original arithmetic antecedents and their common outer threshold remain unchanged.
approval_scope: Complete human proof of the selected normalized Core and selected Raw implication from their exact original arithmetic antecedents. The formal proof is a standing accepted source; no Lean replay was performed.
